title: It's not just olive oil: 3 reasons, printed from woodblocks
concept: Each reason is a fresh sheet laid on a print run and inked by a roller: a one-colour woodblock world (olive tree cut in reverse, a monumental Koroneiki olive, a 0.2% acidity numeral bleeding off the sheet). The opening lie 'It's just olive oil.' is gouged out and corrected on the final sheet beside the £35 discovery box.
